name: provider-chat-completions
description: Call the active Codex provider's OpenAI-compatible Chat Completions API with a caller-supplied model and messages.

interface.shortDescription: Call the active provider with a chosen model and messages.
interface.longDescription: Makes one safe OpenAI-compatible Chat Completions call using the provider credential cache populated by Codex Sync. The caller supplies the model and messages; this plugin does not add prompts, choose models, or perform fallback generation.
defaultPrompt: Call the active provider's Chat Completions API with this model and messages.
Return the normalized Chat Completions result without changing the request.
